name: 地域と検索の設定をまとめたクイック設定シート
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0110 地域と検索の設定をまとめたクイック設定シート.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: cropped original quick-settings sheet: controls and icon geometry. Image 3: secondary-component-preview. Image 4: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Generate one polished, compact-but-readable quick-settings bottom sheet matching the 366x588 Japanese mock. Text must be exact: クイック設定; 言語と地域; 表示言語; ボタンや案内の表示に使用します。; 英語（英国）; 地域; 検索結果に使用する地域です。; 米国; 検索の設定; テーマ; 表示方法を選びます。; 安全な検索; 露骨な内容を除外します。; すべての設定. Preserve the content order, line breaks, 16px horizontal inset, compact vertical rhythm, rounded outer sheet, two white grouped cards, and small title/label sizes. Use separate Aa and globe icons for the language/region rows, brush for Theme, shield for Safe search, down chevrons in the two value fields, X close icon, and the three-source theme selector icons (sun, moon, high contrast) with the last mode selected. Build accurate crisp thin line icons, not text substitutions or question-mark glyphs. Use pure white card surfaces, light neutral sheet, forest green only for selected state and CTA, dark slate labels, gray helpers, muted slate unselected icons. No device/browser frame, app branding, extra controls, or added whitespace.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; Do not invent an outer card around a flat component. Only existing card surfaces use rounded corners, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows; flat headings, lists and settings stay flat white. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: Adapt the visible selected theme state and primary action to Lighthouse forest green. Keep neutral surfaces, grayscale helper copy, and slate secondary details.
LATEST DIRECT OWNER DENSITY CORRECTION:
The owner says the 354x44 LH07-0025 version was too large/spacious, while the 180x28 version was too compact. Use a comfortable middle with readable Japanese typography and balanced label padding. LH07-0025 v006 at 300x40 is the calibration for that segmented control only; never force this size or the prior 180x28 target onto unrelated components. Follow each component original source for anatomy and component-specific proportions.
